models.inverse_notes: MTBF = A*MTTR/(1-A) needs A != 1; MTTR = MTBF*(1-A)/A needs A != 0. Check: A=0.99998,MTTR=2 gives MTBF = 0.99998*2/0.00002 = 99998 (rounding of 100000). A=1 forces MTTR=0 with MTBF free; A=0 forces MTBF=0 against guard (degenerate never-up). Algebraic only.
limitations: Inherent (design-control) scope only; achieved/operational availability with logistics and preventive downtime need separate records.
MTBF > 0 required: a never-operating (MTBF=0) degenerate has no steady-state availability.
MTBF/MTTR are estimated inputs with often-high uncertainty (source basic example warns MTTF-class parameters are uncertain); never measured claims about real hardware.

references.method: EventHelix component table: input transducer MTBF 100000 h, MTTR 2 h gives 99.998%. 100000/100002 = 0.99998 exactly to shown digits.
